invariants.statement: Counterparty.id is the only canonical business/legal identity; metadata is display, discovery, validation, or snapshot data.
Client.counterpartyId resolves to exactly one existing customer-role Counterparty.
Rental.counterpartyId is canonical; when Rental.clientId exists, Client.counterpartyId must match it.
Classic Rental is authoritative and Gantt customer relation fields are a stable-ID projection.
Payment.counterpartyId is canonical; Payment.clientId is optional compatibility and supplier/contractor Payments require no Client.
Production writes and access scope never resolve Counterparty, Client, Rental, or Payment identity from name, INN, phone, or address.
Historical records may retain archived Counterparty references, while new active relations to archived Counterparties are rejected.
Audit/repair is deterministic, stable-ID-only, idempotent, dry-run capable, and apply creates a SQLite backup before transactional writes.
Counterparty migration changes identity propagation only and does not change finance arithmetic.

violations.invariant: Startup must not perform automatic identity repair.
violations.rootCause: I-B/I-D foundation helpers remained wired into every startup and could create Counterparties or add roles.
violations.resolution: Removed both identity mutation calls from startup wiring; retained read-only audits.

violations.invariant: Every Payment mutation must enforce canonical Counterparty relation.
violations.rootCause: Approved correction merged a sanitized patch directly into payments without invoking the Stage I-G resolver.
violations.resolution: Canonicalize the full candidate before write and return structured relation errors atomically.

violations.invariant: Canonical Counterparty ID must win in authorization scope.
violations.rootCause: An OR between counterpartyId and clientId could grant access through a conflicting compatibility ID.
violations.resolution: Use direct rentalId first, then counterpartyId exclusively when present, otherwise clientId compatibility.

violations.invariant: Rental route prefill must not turn a display name into a relation ID.
violations.rootCause: Legacy client query text was matched to Client.company/clientLabel.
violations.resolution: Only explicit clientId route context is accepted; legacy text is invalid and requires operator selection.

violations.invariant: Rental consumers must not restore Client identity by display name.
violations.rootCause: Legacy UI enrichment grouped profile, debt, and Rental data by company/client snapshot when IDs were absent.
violations.resolution: Use Counterparty ID precedence and Client ID compatibility only.

violations.invariant: Gantt must remain a stable-ID projection of Classic Rental.
violations.rootCause: Fuzzy normalized company-name matching could infer a Classic Rental candidate.
violations.resolution: Removed fuzzy matcher; candidate inference requires matching stable Counterparty IDs or, only when neither side has one, matching Client IDs.

violations.invariant: Counterparty identity must survive Classic-to-Gantt frontend projection.
violations.rootCause: Frontend projection copied clientId and display fields but omitted counterpartyId.
violations.resolution: Copy canonical counterpartyId in both projection constructors.

violations.invariant: Critical relation collections cannot persist duplicate stable IDs.
violations.rootCause: Generic and Rental bulk APIs validated relations but did not reject duplicate/missing entity IDs.
violations.resolution: Reject missing or duplicate IDs for clients, rentals, gantt_rentals, and payments before persistence.

violations.invariant: Archiving cannot create an invalid active Rental relation.
violations.rootCause: Direct Counterparty-only active Rentals were not covered by Client/Object archive guards.
violations.resolution: Block archive for active Classic/Gantt Rental references; allow terminal history.

violations.invariant: Historical archived relations must be distinguishable from forbidden active writes.
violations.rootCause: Audits classified every archived target as broken even for terminal Rental and recorded Payment history.
violations.resolution: Audit historical Payment and terminal Rental references with allowArchived while keeping mutation resolvers strict.
